answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 47047 Country: India Title: Bank Job Question: I am an MCA graduate. Because of few reasons I did not go for the software engineer job. I thought of trying for BANKING jobs but later I came to know that it is haram. Further I also came to know that the insurance based jobs are also haram. So I finally thought of trying for a government jobs, but these govt. jobs notifications are very rarely released. It has been one year waiting for these govt jobs. Coming the banking jobs they are very frequently released. So please suggest me what to do now? Answer ID: 47047 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1111/856/D=9/1434) It is unlawful to do the job of writing or documenting the interest accounts and dealings. You should avoid doing job in bank if your job involves such kind of work, but if there are other works related to you then it is allowable. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
